user_sees: Bigger text that wraps; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

steps.action: Open Up next
user_sees: 'Week 3 · easy week in week 6'
must_not: A week number counted from Monday instead of the start day
Week 0

steps.action: In week 6, open Up next and start the workout
user_sees: 'Easy week until <last day>'
Half the sets at the same weights
must_not: Records or medals claimed in the easy week

steps.action: Open Up next in week 7
user_sees: 'Week 7 · easy week in week 12'
must_not: Still an easy week
Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

note: The week line on Up next

start: Workout tab → Find a plan, no program added before; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With saved data saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Get a routine folder from a ready program, the plan builder or a shared file, an".
user_sees: The old saved data shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old saved data missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything
